verses.1: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus, according to the promise of God, our savior, and the hope of Christ Jesus for us.
verses.2: To Timothy, my beloved son, in the name of faith and love, from God our Father and Jesus Christ, our Lord.
verses.3: As you were invited to come to Ephesus, going towards Macedonia, so that you could teach there in a unified manner.
verses.4: And do not pay attention to myths and genealogies that are completely false. These provide no real benefits; instead, they only bring harm to one’s faith in God.
verses.5: But the goal of this prayer is love from a pure heart, along with good intentions and unwavering faith.
verses.6: Some of them, due to their hesitation, turned to despair.
verses.7: Those who want to be legal experts, but who neither understand what they say nor are they concerned about what they say or about what they say about others.
verses.8: We know that a law is good when it is used in accordance with it.
verses.9: You know that fair laws do not apply to those who are unjust, dishonest, wicked, sinful, cruel, and violent.
verses.10: prostitutes, men who are not truly men, men who deceive others, and those who act in a way that contradicts the teachings of health-related teachings.
verses.11: According to the evangelium of the glory of the merciful God, which I believe in.
verses.12: I am grateful to Him who strengthens me in Christ Jesus, our Lord, for He has given me faith and appointed me for service.
verses.13: The former one was a person who was deceitful, persecuting others, and full of anger. But I was ashamed, because I had done things in spite of not knowing the truth.
verses.14: But the grace of our Lord was extended through faith and love in Jesus Christ.
verses.15: The argument is valid and worthy of acceptance at all times. For Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners. And I am one of those who were saved by Him first.
verses.16: But because of this, I was chosen, so that in me the Christ Jesus might show all long-term patience, as a model for those who would believe in Him and live forever.
verses.17: To that king of ages, who is pure, holy, and alone among gods; honor and glory for all ages. Amen.
verses.18: I present this request to you, son of Timothy, in accordance with the prophecies that were spoken about you in the past. May you be able to lead a just and righteous war against them.
verses.19: Having faith and a good sense of justice, some people abandoned this virtue and went astray in their pursuit of faith.
verses.20: Who are these men named Eumenes and Alexander? I gave them to Satan so that they would not commit any acts of blasphemy.
